report: Read all 13 verses end to end against the candidate table and the dump; found no construction analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

לְ before the divine name: *unto* in vv.1, 2, 7, 8 and unrepresented in v.9 — the ASV writes *worship Jehovah* with a bare object there (rule 40), and *unto* wherever it writes the word. Not a split; the one BSB disagreement (v.9) is the documented attach-to-phrase convention, not an error.
Fused לִפְנֵי/מִפְּנֵי (vv.6, 9, 13) headed on the construct noun throughout; v.6 carries the rule-49 copula inside the fused unit as rule 30 allows.

Supplied *the*: on the anarthrous noun (vv.5, 7, 10, 12, 13) and on the construct noun where no article stands in the chain (vv.5, 8, 11, 12), with the arthrous rectum of v.5 taking its own *the* under rule 29. Consistent.

Copula placement consistent: predicate adjective/participle/noun (vv.4, 5), prepositional predicate (vv.6, 12). Jussive *Let* frames (vv.11, 12) and vocatives (v.1, v.9 bare; v.7 *ye kindreds*) consistent.

The two `added` units are the only ones of their kind: v.8 *due* (supplied lexical adjective on the recast construct relation, competing reading named in the note) and v.10 *that* (asyndetic result clause, rule 55). No verse folds a comparable word elsewhere.

v.12 `בּוֹ` → *is therein* fuses preposition and suffix (the suffix denotes the field, not the relative's antecedent, so it is not resumptive), matching the corpus's 61 `בָּהּ` → *therein* units; `אֲשֶׁר` keeps its own *that*.
Repeated notes flagged by the validator each restate a contract rule (15, 18, 29, rule-11 *unto*), so no convention is recorded. Nothing general learned; no promotions or amendments.
